title: Fix Framework Surface Engine WASM Crate Exports Path and Surface Session Imports
description: Fix invalid export paths in @semio-tech/framework-surface-node-graph-rs and @semio-tech/framework-surface-board-2d-rs package.json pointing to ../../../ relative paths instead of ./pkg/*.js, and update board-2d session importer specifier.
summary: Fixed invalid relative exports paths ('../../../...') in @semio-tech/framework-surface-node-graph-rs and @semio-tech/framework-surface-board-2d-rs package.json to point directly to their './pkg/*.js' outputs. Updated index.tsx's board-2d importer to point at '@semio-tech/framework-surface-board-2d-rs' matching the relocated surface crates pattern and updated vitest.config.ts / package.json accordingly. Verified: Vite transform resolves all 5 framework surface imports without errors.
